note: Iowa DNR reservoir park on Green Valley Lake NW of Creston, with buddy and group sites and 3 camping cabins; paved roads, gravel pads. Lake-side RV pads are 20-21 and 28-30; other RV sites sit inland of the loop road. --Claude
summary: Fees $20/$24 and +$12 full hookup confirmed; fcfs some_sites -> never ('100% reservable'); count 93 -> 87; max rig 70 -> 97; season cleared (off-season camping exists). Lakefront holds on sites 20-21, 28-30; no split.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakefront holds, measured. RA per-site GIS plotted on Esri z19: RV pads 28, 29, 30 (41.1071-41.1074,-94.3914 to -94.3911; max vehicle 70, 70, 50 ft) and 20, 21 (41.1055-41.1056,-94.3907; 45 ft) are about 15-30 m from the shoreline across open grass, on the lake side of the road with no driveway or road between. A shoreline path/riprap edge runs along the water. All fit 23 ft. Sites 25-27 are across the loop road from the grass strip. Tent sites 85-92 hold most of the rest of the shore, 25-ft grass, no RVs. RA's site pages carry no 'Proximity to Water' value; I measured instead. Also site 22 is about 45 m back, marginal.
NO SPLIT: one campground on one peninsula with a single registration and road system, sites 1-100 within about 350 m.

CLOSURE (flag, not written as status since it is days away and over Nov 9): DNR alert, Effective 10/30/2026: 'Green Valley State Park will be closed for camping and general use of the park and lake beginning 10:30 pm November 6th through 4:00 am November 9th' for the Special Antlerless Deer Hunt.
